design.purpose: A warm two-colour scarf for one adult, worked in single crochet from both chunky skeins: green for the first half and blue for the second half.

steps.c: Place the green yarn on the work surface
Place the blue yarn beside the green yarn
Ch 13. Sc in 2nd ch and each ch: 12 sc
Ch 1, turn. Rows 2-10: 12 sc each row
Ch 1, turn. Rows 11-20: 12 sc each row
Cut green yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail
Join blue. Rows 21-30: ch 1, 12 sc each row
Rows 31-40: ch 1, 12 sc. Fasten off last row
Cut blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail
Weave the green tail through nearby stitches
Weave the blue tail through nearby stitches
